purpose: Test whether filtering the Gemma timing/count leg to explicit, single-company, non-market-price/technical headlines improves the existing capped hybrid while keeping Notebook 36's complete unfiltered FinBERT name ranks unchanged.

authorization_and_provenance.classification: user-authorized iterative retrospective information-specificity test, not independent confirmation
authorization_and_provenance.v1_stop: The first Notebook 65 execution stopped before return construction because the canonical filtered FinBERT strongest-event panel had one missing firm-open rank on one session. No portfolio outcome was opened.
authorization_and_provenance.v2_change: Apply the return-blind specificity filter only to Gemma's timing/count leg, which is the tie-abstention mechanism that motivated the test; retain the incumbent unfiltered FinBERT rank leg exactly.
authorization_and_provenance.bounded_exception: Exactly one Gemma metadata filter is tested. No filter sweep, scorer bake-off, tie fallback, threshold, hedge, scaling, allocation, or holding-period search is permitted.

gemma_timing_filter.unit: unique normalized headline before company association and firm-open aggregation
gemma_timing_filter.contextual_handling: contextual is the logical complement of explicit_target in the frozen population
gemma_timing_filter.metadata_source: deterministic frozen headline-value screening fields carried by the completed 888,155-row population; not an LLM sentiment prediction and not human validated
gemma_timing_filter.fallback: no unfiltered Gemma fallback when a headline or firm-open fails the filter

unchanged_strategy.universe: immutable original LSEG sector-33, three companies in each of 11 sectors
unchanged_strategy.timing: first XNYS open at least 15 minutes after the headline's first timestamp
unchanged_strategy.gemma_role: specificity-filtered Gemma strongest-event sign and exact-extrema counts determine active dates and leg breadth
unchanged_strategy.finbert_role: unchanged unfiltered Notebook 36 FinBERT strongest-event cross-sectional ranks choose names
unchanged_strategy.return: one-session split-adjusted open-to-open price return; dividends not back-adjusted

accounting.incumbent: exact Notebook 36 capped hybrid daily path at 10 bps per side

primary_family: Gemma-timing-specificity hybrid net return minus cash
Gemma-timing-specificity hybrid net return minus unchanged Notebook 36 capped hybrid net return
inference.primary_method: two-sided paired circular moving-block bootstrap with BH over both comparisons
inference.factor_test: after-cost sector-spanning HAC(5) intercept using equal-weight market plus ten sector-minus-market factors
inference.temporal_stability: first-half and second-half net mean and Sharpe are predeclared descriptive gates

classification.retrospective_improvement: both primary mean differences are positive with 95% intervals above zero and BH q below 0.05; sector-spanning alpha is positive with its 95% interval above zero and p below 0.05; both half means are positive; break-even exceeds 10 bps per side; at least 60 sessions are active; and maximum absolute name weight is at most 25%
classification.costed_positive_not_improved: the cash comparison passes and both half means are positive, but at least one retrospective-improvement condition fails
classification.nonviable: the cash comparison fails or either half mean is nonpositive

required_reproductions.unfiltered_signal: rebuild the unfiltered hybrid from raw completed score populations and reproduce Notebook 36's target audit and 10-bps daily path within 1e-12
required_reproductions.finbert_rank_invariance: the filtered candidate uses the same complete unfiltered FinBERT ranks as the incumbent
required_reproductions.population: 888155 successful unique hashes for each scorer
